inherited_failures.title: Recording lifecycle directly on a virtual thread is unsupported on both exact base and candidate
inherited_failures.detail: Running the whole added test from a virtual thread fails with IllegalThreadStateException: StackValue must not be used in a virtual thread unless the method is annotated @Uninterruptible, wrapped by Self-suppression not permitted from try-with-resources. Identical virtual-only mode reproduces on both revisions. Final virtual allocation test follows the existing suite pattern: Recording is managed by the platform thread, allocation occurs on the virtual thread.
inherited_failures.disposition: Preexisting limitation, not attributed to this patch and not silently counted as a pass.
